youtube.description:
Connect Gmail to Claude in 4 steps: open Connectors, sign in, ask which emails need a reply, approve before sending.

Connect Gmail to Claude in 4 steps, even on Free. Use a test inbox first.

1. Open - Open Customize, then Connectors.
2. Connect - Pick Gmail or Google Calendar and sign in.
3. Ask - Ask which emails need a reply this week.
4. Approve - Review every draft. Sending needs your approval. Read before you send.

Needs: Free, Pro, Max
